descriptions.w3d_d24g_efmv_borders_start_80063068: EFMV border bars start-up: subscribes to one message with slot +28, posts two value messages with table 0x8040db38, loads the EFMV.Borders mesh into +40 and three settings into +44..+52 with retain/release, sets EFMV.Active, stores the on-time and its end time, then fills two mesh sprites with black opaque colour, position and half height.
